messages:
izzy: Heads up - validator v2.2 rollout is causing a cluster of fncall rejects from one customer route (~10% over 5m). They send an array where we expect an object for `tool_response.rows`.

sam: Can you paste a minimal failing sample?

izzy: Sure:
```json
{
  "tool": "docs.search",
  "tool_response": {
    "rows": [ { "id": "a", "score": 0.95 } ]
  }
}
```

chris: So strict schema rejects ARR->OBJ. Current router sends rejects to degen which surfaces a 5xx to apps. Bad UX.

harper: Two quick asks: prevent billing surprises and make Console useful for Support. Console should link sample -> validation error and show last good sample. Also add a rollout toggle "soft-validate (auto-fallback, no-bill)".

sam: Platform proposal: add a `validation_outcome` metric with labels `status=warn|fail|ok`, `code=ARR_OBJ|MISSING_KEY`, `validator=v2.2`. For warn, route to fallback and set `billing_mode=free_fallback`. For fail, hard reject as today.

izzy: Agree. Also emit `sample_id` hashed in metric and store full sample for 7d in secure audit logs. Console can fetch it via the id.

chris: Alerting: page on `validation_outcome{status=fail} > 1%` or if `warn` rate spikes and fallback latency P90 > 2x. Sampling: keep 100% of fails and 1% of warns.

harper: UX: show a small diff snippet in the Console row + an action to flip soft-validate for that validator. Show estimated token delta when routed to fallback.

sam: I'll implement metric labels + billing flag in rev-router (small change). Add heuristic classifier for ARR_OBJ -> warn. Target hotfix in 90m.

deploy-bot: deploy started by sam for rev-router@hotfix -> env=prod shard=us-east-1

izzy: After deploy, we'll start a 10% canary for the tenant and watch `validation_outcome` for 30m. Support will have links to samples.

chris: I'll draft a short runbook and alert docs.

harper: Thanks team. Priority: stop customer errors and avoid billing complaints.
